title: PGx release manifest
description: The payload a release bundle pins and hashes (WP-03). It names exactly which software build, dataset version and ruleset version a release binds together. Its SHA-256 digest over canonical JSON (UTF-8, sorted keys, fixed separators) is stored as release_bundles.manifest_hash. No wall-clock timestamp appears anywhere in this document: the manifest must hash identically whenever it is rebuilt from the same records.

schema_version.description: Manifest shape version. Part of the hashed payload, so a shape change cannot silently collide with an older digest.

software.description: The registered build the release ran under. Pinned by identity and source tree, not by the declared version string alone: two builds may declare the same version and differ in code.

dataset.description: The dataset version the release pins. Only a PUBLISHED dataset may back an activated release; the status is recorded here so the manifest states what was true when it was built.

ruleset.description: The ruleset version the release pins, including its exact membership. Membership is what makes this a pin rather than a label: two rulesets sharing a public ID and differing in members produce different digests.

member_count.description: Must equal the length of rule_ids. A count that disagrees with the list it counts makes the manifest self-contradictory.

rule_ids.description: Rule identities, sorted by the domain so the digest does not depend on query order. Array order is significant to the hash.

digest.description: Canonical digest spelling produced by pgx.domain.hashing.sha256_digest.
